capabilities: File notes into folders by per-vault rules
File notes manually to chosen destinations
Preview files and lines before applying
extras: Desktop-only. Also checks for exact and similar duplicates and moves deleted copies to a recoverable Deleted folder. The managed OpenRouter key has a USD $1 lifetime limit with no reset; settings, credentials and undo history are stored locally.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to route notes into folders by rules or with AI help, so filing is done by hand.

relations.evidence: Configure your own OpenAI key through Obsidian Secret Storage
OpenRouter is the default provider for new installations.
AI planning uses a connected Constance account and organize-run credits

summary: Note organizer that files notes into folders using per-vault rules, manual destinations or AI routing, with previews and undo.
